adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` now compute the fallback calendar id as:

```ts
externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId
```

When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the fallback branch), the predicate `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` compares against `undefined`/`null`, so it will not match a normal destination calendar entry (whose `externalId` is a string). This makes the fallback return `undefined` instead of using the destination calendar’s `externalId` (e.g., first element). The file also defines `defaultCalendarId = "primary"`, so downstream deletion is likely to target the wrong calendar (primary) or fail, consistent with the finding.
